title: Oncogenic R248W mutation induced conformational perturbation of the p53 core domain and the structural protection by proteomimetic amyloid inhibitor ADH-6.
authors: Liu, Qian; Yu, Yawei; Wei, Guanghong
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子分子动力学模拟研究p53核心域R248W致癌突变引起的构象扰动及淀粉样抑制剂ADH-6的结构保护机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作相关（p53为转录因子）但聚焦突变致聚集而非TF-DNA结合特异性，方法为MD模拟，与本课题部分相关。
abstract: The involvement of p53 aggregation in cancer pathogenesis emphasizes the importance of unraveling the mechanisms underlying mutation-induced p53 destabilization. And understanding how small molecule inhibitors prevent the conversion of p53 into aggregation-primed conformations is pivotal for the development of therapeutics targeting p53-aggregation-associated cancers. A recent experimental study highlights the efficacy of the proteomimetic amyloid inhibitor ADH-6 in stabilizing R248W p53 and inhibiting its aggregation in cancer cells by interacting with the p53 core domain (p53C). However, it remains mostly unclear how R248W mutation induces destabilization of p53C and how ADH-6 stabilizes this p53C mutant and inhibits its aggregation. Herein, we conducted all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of R248W p53C in the absence and presence of ADH-6, as well as that of wild-type (WT) p53C. Our simulations reveal that the R248W mutation results in a shift of helix H2 and beta-hairpin S2-S2' towards the mutation site, leading to the destruction of their neighboring beta-sheet structure. This further facilitates the formation of a cavity in the hydrophobic core, and reduces the stability of the beta-sandwich. Importantly, two crucial aggregation-prone regions (APRs) S9 and S10 are disturbed and more exposed to solvent in R248W p53C, which is conducive to p53C aggregation. Intriguingly, ADH-6 dynamically binds to the mutation site and multiple destabilized regions in R248W p53C, partially inhibiting the shift of helix H2 and beta-hairpin S2-S2', thus preventing the disruption of the beta-sheets and the formation of the cavity. ADH-6 also reduces the solvent exposure of APRs S9 and S10, which disfavors the aggregation of R248W p53C. Moreover, ADH-6 can preserve the WT-like dynamical network of R248W p53C. Our study elucidates the mechanisms underlying the oncogenic R248W mutation induced p53C destabilization and the structural protection of p53C by ADH-6.
abstract_zh: p53聚集在癌症发病机制中的参与强调了揭示突变诱导的p53去稳定化机制的重要性。理解小分子抑制剂如何阻止p53转化为聚集倾向构象，对于开发靶向p53聚集相关癌症的治疗药物至关重要。近期一项实验研究强调了蛋白模拟淀粉样抑制剂ADH-6通过作用于p53核心结构域（p53C）在癌细胞中稳定R248W p53并抑制其聚集的有效性。然而，R248W突变如何诱导p53C去稳定化以及ADH-6如何稳定该p53C突变体并抑制其聚集，目前仍大多不清楚。在此，我们对不存在和存在ADH-6情况下的R248W p53C以及野生型（WT）p53C进行了全原子分子动力学模拟。我们的模拟揭示，R248W突变导致螺旋H2和β-发夹S2-S2'向突变位点移动，从而破坏其邻近的β-折叠结构。这进一步促进疏水核心中空腔的形成，并降低β-三明治结构的稳定性。重要的是，在R248W p53C中，两个关键的聚集倾向区域（APRs）S9和S10受到扰动并更暴露于溶剂，这有利于p53C聚集。有趣的是，ADH-6动态结合于R248W p53C的突变位点和多个去稳定化区域，部分抑制螺旋H2和β-发夹S2-S2'的移动，从而阻止β-折叠的破坏和空腔的形成。ADH-6还减少APRs S9和S10的溶剂暴露，这不利于R248W p53C的聚集。此外，ADH-6能保持R248W p53C的类WT动态网络。我们的研究阐明了致癌性R248W突变诱导p53C去稳定化以及ADH-6对p53C结构保护的机制。
